name: data.gov.au CKAN API
tagline: Australian federal open-data portal for dataset discovery and resource access via CKAN.
description: The data.gov.au portal exposes a CKAN Action API for searching Australian government open datasets, listing organizations and groups, and retrieving dataset/resource metadata. Developers use package_search, package_show, and related action endpoints to discover and access federal open data without needing a paid plan for public read operations.

auth.details: Public read endpoints require no authentication. API keys may be needed for write/admin actions if available.

use_cases: search Australian open government datasets by keyword
get metadata for a specific dataset by id or name
list organizations publishing open data on data.gov.au
find downloadable resource URLs for a dataset
